title: A demo build's checks no longer fail what the build was asked to do, the picture to replace is named where it lives, a map link to the template's street fails, and the logo is the business's own and stays transparent
steps: S1: compareAgentInventory on a WordPress post whose tag "Fish" is renamed (among its relations and in its own data), a header part without its last newline, an EmDash key set null, a slide picture written without its wp-image class; then a post given more tags, a lost block and a lost figure.
S2: picturesWhere on a no-demo-pictures finding with wp-image-35 on /about-us, the file on two pages' records; banner-1.jpg beside a record whose anchor reads acm-text-banner-130.
S3: checkCtaReal on site-search links worded "Special orders"; checkFactsFromBrief on "03 2014-2017" and on map links searching the template's street, the held street and a place name.
S4: cutForPlace with keepAlpha on a transparent logo, an opaque photo carrying an alpha channel; chooseLogo on q-on-the-go-logo.png (larger) and q-patisserie.png with the place's name.

S5: the WordPress inventory read twice — a sidebar part from the theme file, then stored by the build (id 511) with the two term rows WordPress files it under; then one post filed under one more category; then a starting inventory read without the site's own rows told apart.
S6: checkNoDemoWords on the template's short lines "Bar & Restaurant", "Our Bakery", "Mon - Fri", "Est. 1982" kept as they were, with research that says "restaurants" and "the restaurant".
expect: S1: the renamed tag, the newline, the null key and the class-less picture pass; more tags, the lost block and the lost figure fail.
S2: the finding names the /about-us record and the block numbered as content.get {outline:true} numbers it; banner-1 is named in no record (no `in`), its sized copy rest-1-768x384 is.
S3: search links pass; the timeline years are no phone; only the template street's map link fails (kind map).
S4: the logo stays PNG with a clear corner, the photo is a JPEG; the logo naming the place is chosen.
S5: the stored part and its two rows pass; the extra category fails; the older starting read still compares every row (the two rows fail there, the unchanged site passes).
S6: "bar & restaurant" and "est. 1982" fail; "Our Bakery" and "Mon - Fri" pass.
fence: relationCopy tags_input; withoutNulls; picturesWhere; SEARCH_PARAM; ADDRESS_TEXT maps; cutForPlace keepAlpha demoTransparency; chooseLogo namesPlace; tags_input in post data; template file/source; taxonomyRelations own rows; short blocks judged word by word (foreignWord, SMALL_WORDS)

tests: a WordPress tag renamed is the same tag; a post given more tags differs
WordPress: a template part the build stores is the same part, and the rows WordPress files it under are not the site’s relations
blank space around and between tags is no structure; a lost block still is
a key holding null is a key left out; a key holding a value is not
a WordPress picture written without its wp-image class is the same picture; a lost figure is not
picturesWhere names the record and the WordPress block of each template picture, numbered as the outline is
cta-real: a link searching this site is a search suggestion, a booking word or not; off the site it is not
facts-from-brief: a map link searching another street fails; the held street, a place name or no address held do not
keepAlpha keeps a transparent logo transparent (PNG); without it the cut stays a JPEG
a logo naming the place wins over a larger sister brand, read or unread
no-demo-words: a short template heading with a word that is neither the brief’s nor the site’s furniture is copy left
